meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.8.4
§ Anaiah = "Jehovah has answered"
a priest who helped Ezra and signed the covenant with Nehemiah

elsewhere.note: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah…
